definition: A vacation interval is confirmed free only if every requested in-scope schedule establishes no MLB, NFL/49ers, Stanford, Cal, or Westwood One NFL broadcast during the interval. Unreleased schedules are not treated as game-free.
conclusion: No verified 1-, 2-, or 3-week vacation interval can be certified from the official schedules currently available. The 2027 MLB calendar alone closes the apparent post-Super-Bowl gap after four days because MLB spring games begin February 19. NFL and college 2027-2029 schedules are not yet available, so even those four dates are only a candidate interval, not a fully confirmed free window.
